Subject: Inquiry from pricing page — demo + budget

Hi Ben,

I just submitted a request via your pricing page CTA — BrightLedger is evaluating inference vendors and we have a defined budget for Q1. I'm leading the vendor evaluation for observability and inference costs.

High level: we run ~120M tokens/month currently in production (mixed seq lengths), latency needs for interactive features under 350ms p99, and strong interest in private VPC deployment for data residency. We're hoping to get a demo this week or early next week to validate performance and understand unit economics.

Preferred times:
- Mon Jan 11: 10–12 PT
- Tue Jan 12: 14–16 PT

Also, happy to loop in procurement — procurement@brightledger.com — once we confirm scope.

Can you share a short agenda and any pricing snapshot ahead of the call?

Thanks,
Alex Ramos

BrightLedger
